plain_english_policy: This bill centralizes authority over livestock care to the state level while prohibiting local governments from regulating these activities on private property.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Enactment would produce a policy direction of preemption, removing local regulatory power regarding livestock husbandry and reserving it exclusively for the Department of Agriculture and Industries. It simultaneously strengthens state enforcement capabilities by clarifying the State Veterinarian's role in disease control and increasing penalties for animal cruelty.
sponsorship_supports_position: The sponsors affirmatively advanced a bill that restricts local legislative power over private agricultural practices to ensure uniform state regulation of livestock and disease control.
evidence_quotes: This bill would prohibit local governments from adopting laws and rules relating to livestock and animal husbandry on private property.

No county or municipal governing body may adopt or continue in effect any ordinance, rule, or resolution concerning the care and handling of livestock or animal husbandry practices involved in the production of agricultural and farm products on private property.
